STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #42

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 01, 2016

This year Social Security announced a COLA (Cost of Living Allowance) increase effective 2017. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 0.3% increases for 2017:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards; An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum; and An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard Medicare Part A and B premiums Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

In addition to the COLA change, this manual change consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Also, we have replaced all reference to Family Medicaid with MAGI Medicaid and updated the links to the new MAGI Medicaid manual.

Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

505-E CASEWORKER ACTIONS RELATED TO TPL/TPR

Clarified that termination of TPL Third Party Liability must be verified.

505-H MILITARY FACILITIES

Removed this subsection due to outdated DHCS Division of Health Care Services information.

513 ALASKA RESIDENCY

Revised this section to match MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income manual for consistency.

514-D PENAL INSTITUTION

Revised subsection to match MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income manual for consistency.

514-G CHILDREN IN TREATMENT

Added new subsection regarding children that have been in residential treatment for more than 30 days that are ineligible for MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid.

520-L ABLE ACCOUNTS

Added new subsection explaining new ABLE Achieving a Better Life Experience Act accounts with a link to the APA Adult Public Assistance manual section.

560-E HCB WAIVER REFERRALS AND INTERAGENCY COMMUNICATIONS

Replaced DSDS Division of Senior and Disabilities Services with Aged and Disability Resource Center for the care coordinator list per DSDS Division of Senior and Disabilities Services request.

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #44

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: July 3, 2017

We are making changes to clarify existing policies and align policies with those in the MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid Manual. Other changes are either technical in nature, clarifications that are the result of policy questions, or suggestions from the field. This manual change reflects the updated Medicaid policies, as well as corrects some errors from past manual changes.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 505 Third Party Liability and Recovery

Added information regarding FMAP Federal Medicaid Assistance Percentage and the important of using the correct Medicaid category and subtype, and indicating IHS Indian Health Service eligibility

MS 505-C Applicant/Recipient Responsibility

Clarified that verification of TPR/TPL termination is required

MS 528-A Initial Case Processing

Clarified that the Policy & Program Development Unit will enter a case note on the existing Medicaid case number when approving a Medicaid Qualified Trust

Updated instructions regarding how to find a trust in CourtView

MS 554-L 6 Transfer Penalty and Partial Months

Updated DHCS email by replacing Doug Myers to DHCS.Systems@alaska.gov

MS 560-F HCB Waiver Services and Institutional Eligibility

Removed the note referencing the FASD waiver as this is no longer a valid waiver type

ADDENDUM 2

Removed institutionalized from SI description as this is not correct

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

This year Social Security announced a COLA (Cost of Living Allowance) increase effective 2018. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 2.0% increases for 2018:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum; and

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard

Medicare Part A and B premiums

Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

In addition to the COLA change, this manual change consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

527-B SPECIAL NEEDS TRUST

Clarified that an individual can set up a Special Needs Trust (SNT) due to a law change

533 DISABLED CHILDREN AT HOME (TEFRA)

Replaced terminology "Plan of Care" with "Support Plan" to match Senior & Disabilities Services (SDS) change in terminology as of January 1, 2018

553-D RESOURCE ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION AND ALLOTMENT OF RESOURCES

Updated example due to COLA change

554-D LOOK BACK PERIOD

Updated example with new year for ease in understanding

560 HOME AND COMMUNITY BASED WAIVER SERVICES

Replaced terminology "Plan of Care" with "Support Plan" to match Senior & Disabilities Services (SDS) change in terminology as of January 1, 2018

560-B HCB WAIVER TYPES

Added new Individualized Supports (IS) Waiver type

Explained new Community First Choice (CFC) services that have been added to the Medicaid State Plan as of January 1, 2018

560-C ELIGIBILITY FOR HCB WAIVER SERVICES

Added new Individualized Supports (IS) Waiver type

562 PROCESSING HCB WAIVER CASES

Replaced terminology "Plan of Care" with "Support Plan" to match Senior & Disabilities Services (SDS) change in terminology as of January 1, 2018

570 POST ELIGIBILITY AND COST-OF-CARE

Replaced terminology "Plan of Care" with "Support Plan" to match Senior & Disabilities Services (SDS) change in terminology as of January 1, 2018

ADDENDUM 1 PROGRAM STANDARDS

Updated due to COLA change

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #49

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 03, 2018

This year Social Security announced a COLA (Cost of Living Allowance) increase effective January 2019. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 2.8% increase for 2019:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

In addition to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change, this manual change consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 505 B What is a Third Party Resource

Added long term care insurance to the list of third party resources and a note explaining how to notify TPL Third Party Liability if a long term care insurance policy exists.

MS 554 D Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

MS 562 A MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Waiver Cases

Removed the statement that MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income waiver cases do not impose a transfer of asset penalty. MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income waiver cases do impose a transfer of asset penalty.

MS 570 E Allowable Deductions for Cost-Of-Care

Added a note to clarify that deductions must be verified before they are allowed to be used as a deduction.

MS 570 E(3) Family Member Allowance

Updated section to clarify how a Family Member Allowance should be calculated and corrected reference from the MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid standards to the ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standards.

MS 570 H Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

MS 570 J Home and Community Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

Addendum 1

Updated standards due to COLA change

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B and Part D premiums for 2019

Updated 2019 Spousal Impoverishment Standards

Addendum 2

Removed MAGI Medicaid subtypes to eliminate confusion

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #50

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: April 1, 2019

We have updated the Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility. We are making several changes to clarify existing policy as a result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 506-C Medicare Card

Updated section with the new Medicare Card that was revised in 2018

MS 520-N Ineligible Spouse Retirement Fund

Added new subsection explaining that an ineligible spouse's retirement fund is an exempt resource

MS 528-A Initial Case Processing

Updated #2 to state Policy will email the specific caseworker who sent in the trust along with their Eligibility Office Manager and Regional Manager when approving or denying trusts

MS 534-K Example of an Eligibility Determination

Updated this section to reflect the 2019 Federal Poverty Level changes

MS 534-M Example of an Eligibility Determination with a Medicaid Qualifying Trust

Updated this section to reflect the 2019 Federal Poverty Level changes

MS 561-F APDD, IDD, or ALI Waivers with APA Cash Assistance

Added eligibility codes 71 & 74 to the 21 and over in the table as the IDD waiver does not have an age limit

MS 562-F HCB Waiver Cases for a Women Receiving Breast and Cervical Cancer Medicaid

Added Ladies First in parenthesis after BCHC in the title of this section as Alaska changed the name of the program in 2018 (The Federal Government has not changed the name of the BCHC program)

MS 570 Post Eligibility and Cost of Care

Clarified that cost of care is determined using total gross income minus allowable deductions and disregards

MS 570-A Definitions

Added to Total Gross Income definition, including money deposited in a Medicaid Qualifying Trust

MS 575 BCHC Screening

Added Ladies First in parenthesis after BCHC in the title of this section as Alaska changed the name of the program in 2018 (The Federal Government has not changed the name of the BCHC program)

Added that Alaska updated the BCHC program to be called "Ladies First" in 2018

MS 575-B Application

Updated LTC office location from suite 410 to 120

Addendum 1

Updated with 2019 FPL Changes

Addendum 2

Added Ladies First to BCHC (Breast and Cervical Health Check)

Updated QM & SL resource limit

Addendum 8 III. 1619B Eligibility

Updated where to find the 1619B list in Luminist due to a program change from Document Direct to Luminist

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #51

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 3, 2019

We have provided updated information regarding how to handle an individual who appears eligible for Medicare benefits, and changed the terminology from Medicare Premium Assistance Categories to Medicare Savings Programs to match the federal language.

This and other policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 506 Medicare

Removed "buy-in" from the title of this section as this was causing confusion for staff.

Rewrote entire section for clarity and linked to MS 580.

MS 523(J) Alaska Native / American Indian Property Rents

Added new subsection clarifying that rental income received from exempt property in Alaska belonging to an Alaska Native / American Indian is exempt. This is true for the Medicaid eligibility decision and determining cost of care.

MS 528(A) Initial Case Processing

Added note explaining that it is a best practice to fund a trust by having all income direct deposited into the trust account.

Revised the process regarding how to communicate trust approvals and denials with the field offices.

MS 528(D) Processing Renewals with Trusts

Added note explaining that is a best practice to fund the trust by having all income direct deposited into the trust account.

MS 533(D) Case Processing

Added note clarifying that there is no eligible for retroactive TEFRA Medicaid due to the level of care requirement not being met.

MS 570 Post Eligibility Treatment of Income (Cost of Care)

Changed title of section from Post Eligibility and Cost of Care to Post Eligibility Treatment of Income (Cost of Care) to match federal terminology.

MS 570(A) Definitions

Added definitions of Medical and Remedial Expenses.

MS 570(E) Unpaid Medical Expense Allowance

Updated section explaining what medical costs are.

MS 570(E)(6) Home Maintenance Allowance

Updated section clarifying that home maintenance expenses must be verified before the allowance is given and that the amount shall be the same as the expenses up to the maximum allowance, which is the APA need standard for an individual living independently.

MS 570(F) When a Cost of Care Liability Begins and Ends

Deleted statement indicating an individual could make advanced payments towards a nursing home facility for future month's cost of care as this does not follow federal regulations. The individual must be legally obligated to pay the bill before payment can be made. Payment of any expense before services are provided or before the individual has received the benefit is not allowed.

MS 580 Medicare Savings Programs

Changed name of section from Medicare Premium Assistance Categories to Medicare Savings Programs to match federal terminology.

Rewrote entire section for clarity.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #52

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 2, 2019

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2020. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 1.6% increase for 2020:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

In addition to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change, we have expanded the use of the Refused Cash ( RC Refused Cash ) Medicaid subtype effective with the benefit month of January 2020 to include individuals who have countable income above the appropriate APA Adult Public Assistance need/payment standard but below the Expanded Refused Cash monthly income limit listed in ADLTC MS 530(C) .

This manual change also consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

500(A) Applicable Eligibility Categories

Revised section to include an explanation of "Expanded Refused Cash" Medicaid eligibility

Clarified that QMB, SLMB, SLMB Plus, and QDWI are Medicare Savings Programs that do not offer Medicaid coverage and added a link to ADLTC MS 580

515 TEFRA Case Processing

Changed Qualis name to Comagine throughout the chapter due to company name change and updated to current dates

520(I) Fair Hearings

Added a link to Admin MS 117-2

530(B) APA Recipient

Revised table explanation of the SI and ST Medicaid subtypes for clarity

530(C) SSI or APA Eligible, But Not Receiving Cash Payments

Changed title due to the expanded use of the RC Refused Cash Medicaid subtype

Added the Expanded Refused Cash income limits

Revised table explanation of the RC Refused Cash Medicaid subtype due to a change in policy

533 Disabled Children at Home (TEFRA) whole chapter

Changed Qualis name to Comagine due to company name change

554(D) Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

562(B) APA Related Medicaid or LTC Medicaid Waiver Cases

Changed Qualis name to Comagine due to company name change

570(H) Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

570(J) Home and Community Based Waiver Case Example

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase

575(D) Coverage

Changed Qualis name to Comagine due to company name change

Addendum 1

Updated standards due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2020

Updated 2020 Spousal Impoverishment Standards

Updated QMB, SLMB, QI Resource Limits

Updated Pickle Amendment Table

Addendum 2

Revised table explanation of the RC Medicaid subtype due to a change in policy

Revised Table explanation of the SI and ST Medicaid subtypes for clarity

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #53

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: April 1, 2020

We have updated the 2020 Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility effective April 1, 2020. We have also updated other sections that use Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility.

This manual change also consists of several technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

506(A) Medicare Eligibility

Clarified that an individual must be receiving SSDI Social Security Disability Insurance in order to qualify for Medicare benefits

516 Retroactive Medicaid

Revised section for clarity and to align with MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid

520(A) Application and Review Process

Clarified that an application and interview are required when an individual is moving from a MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid category to an Old Age/Disability related Medicaid category

520(B) Proof of United States Citizenship and Qualified Alien Status

Replaced Bureau of Vital Statistics (BVS) with Health Analytics & Vital Records (HAVR)

528(A) Initial Case Processing

Clarified that a trust should not be sent to policy for review until the interview has been completed and the application is ready to be approved (other than the trust approval)

528(G) Trust Changes

Clarified that amended trusts and the associated court paperwork must be sent to policy for approval

530(C) Use of the Refused Cash Medicaid Subtype

Removed Expanded Refused Cash income limits and added a link to it on the ADLTC Addendum 1

533(A) TEFRA Eligibility

Clarified that when a TEFRA child is turning 18, they must be referred to apply for SSI

Added that Child Support received on behalf of a TEFRA child is countable income to the child

533(B) TEFRA Conversions

Clarified that if a child's SSI benefit stops, the caseworker must evaluate the child's eligibility for MAGI Medicaid, TEFRA, and a CEP.

533(E) TEFRA Reviews

Clarified that at the time of review, the caseworker must check the child's age. If the child is turning 18 years old, they must be referred to apply for SSI.

534(K) Example of an Eligibility Determination

Updated examples with 2020 Federal Poverty Level Changes and replaced APA Need Standard with Refused Cash standard

534(M) Example of an Eligibility Determination With a Medicaid Qualifying Trust

Updated examples with 2020 Federal Poverty Level Changes and replaced APA Need Standard with Refused Cash standard

554(E) Penalty Start Date

Clarified when a TOA penalty begins

554(L) Transfer Penalty and Partial Months

Updated dates in the examples

Updated DHCS contact email to dhcs.systems@alaska.gov

561 EIS HCB Waiver Codes

Removed charts throughout this section as this process information is not maintained by the policy unit

Move eligibility and waiver codes to Addendum 2

570(E) 6 Home Maintenance Allowance

Updated the amount used for home maintenance allowance as equal to the Expanded Refused Cash Medicaid income limit instead of the APA need/payment standard

570(H) Nursing Home Examples

Updated examples with 2020 Community Spouse Monthly Maintenance Need Standards

570(J) Home and Community-Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated examples with 2020 Community Spouse Monthly Maintenance Need Standards

576(F) EIS Information

Deleted section and added information to Addendum 2

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Updated QMB & SLMB resource limits

Addendum 1

Updated with 2020 Federal Poverty Level Changes

Added 2020 Expanded Refused Cash Income Limits

Updated QMB, SLMB, and SLMB+ Resource Limits

Addendum 2

Added subtypes for Undocumented Illegal Aliens due to CMS reporting requirements

Added a list of eligibility and waiver codes

Addendum 4

Added the Help Desk will contact Policy to determine if the request is valid and can be approved

Addendum 7

Revised information for Medicaid Part D, including a new link to the SDS website

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #54

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 1, 2020

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy, clarifying existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

520(B) U.S. United States CITIZENSHIP AND ELIGIBLE ALIEN STATUS

Updated section to align with MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income MS 808-6 as the HAVR Health Analytics & Vital Records ( BVS Bureau of Vital Statistics ) data match has ended.

534 WORKING DISABLED MEDICAID BUY-IN

Clarified when calculating the unearned income test, apply APA Adult Public Assistance related methodology or 300% Special Long Term Care income limit depending on what category of Medicaid eligibility is based on.

575 BREAST AND CERVICAL CANCER MEDICAID

Explained what credible coverage means.

Added renewals are required yearly.

580 MEDICARE SAVINGS PROGRAMS

Updated who is eligible section to include MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income caretaker category.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #55

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 1, 2020

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2021. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 1.3% increase for 2021:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

This manual change also consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

517 Fair Hearings

Added a new chapter to match federal regulations that allow a verbal fair hearing request for Medicaid.

518 Alien Sponsor Income

Added a new chapter to clarify Alien Sponsor Income deeming.

520(F) Verification and Documentation

Added a link to APA MS 410-4 for further clarification on verification.

520(I) Reserved

Revised section as reserved due to fair hearing policy is no longer the same as APA. See ADLTC 517 .

523(B) Reserved

Revised to reserved due to information moved Alien Sponsor Income to new chapter ADLTC 518 .

524(A) Reserved

Revised to reserved due to information moved Alien Sponsor Income to new chapter ADLTC 518 .

532(C) Alien Sponsor Deeming

Removed outdated section and moved Alien Sponsor Income to new chapter ADLTC 518 .

Renumbered section.

554(D) Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase.

570(A) Definitions

Added note clarifying that Native Dividend income over $2,000 is countable, even if deposited to a trust.

570(C) Individuals Not Subject to Cost of Care

Clarified that SSI and APA recipients are not responsible for cost of care.

570(H) Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase.

570(J) Home and Community Based Waiver Case Example

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance increase.

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Added a note that incarcerated individuals are not eligible for Medicare Savings Programs.

Updated the QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries and SLMB Specified Low Income Medicare Beneficiaries resource limits.

Updated LIS resource limits and coverage information.

Addendum 1

Updated standards due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2021

Updated 2021 Spousal Impoverishment Standards

Updated QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries and SLMB Specified Low Income Medicare Beneficiaries resource limits

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #56

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: April 1, 2021

We have updated the 2021 Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility effective April 1, 2021. We have also updated other sections that use Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility.

This manual change also consists of several technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

514(D) Penal Institutions

Removed verbiage indicating applications for adults in DOC Department of Corrections or BOP Federal Bureau of Prisions custody will be processed by Field Services as this is no longer the case

520(A) Application and Review Process

Added language regarding signature requirements

Clarified that a NFAP Native Family Assistance Program application can be used as an application and recertification

520(B) Proof of United States Citizenship and Qualified Aliens

Removed subsection C regarding use of the PFD Permanent Fund Dividend interface as verification of US Citizenship as this no longer meets policy requirements

522(A) Special Non-Immigrant Groups

Due to a change in law effective December 27, 2020, clarified that non-immigrants from the Federated States of Micronesia, the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the Republic of Palau who are legally residing in the United States are eligible for Medicaid benefits and are not subject to the 5-year waiting period

524(M) Dingell Act Lands

Added a new subsection regarding the Dingell Act Lands received by Native Veterans

530(A) SSI Recipient

Clarified that Medicaid eligibility does not depend on APA Adult Public Assistance eligibility

534(K) Example of an Eligibility Determination

Updated examples with 2021 Federal Poverty Level Changes and replaced APA Need Standard with Refused Cash standard

534(M) Example of an Eligibility Determination With a Medicaid Qualifying Trust

Updated examples with 2021 Federal Poverty Level Changes and replaced APA Need Standard with Refused Cash standard

Addendum 1

Updated with 2021 Federal Poverty Level Changes

Updated Pickle Chart

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #57

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 1, 2021

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy, clarifying existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

520 A APPLICATION AND REVIEW PROCESS

Clarified that an SSP Self Service Portal / FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace is the only acceptable application that doesn't need a "wet" signature

550 B INDIVIDUAL ELIGIBLE FOR SSI Supplemental Security Income OR APA Adult Public Assistance CASH ASSISTANCE IF NOT IN AN INSTITUTION

Clarified that the Refused Cash category is also included.

554 K ANNUITIES

Clarified how a TOA Transfer of Assets should be calculated with an annuity that has caused a penalty.

576 E COORDINATION WITH DIVISION OF HEALTH CARE SERVICES (DHCS)

Added a note clarifying that the letter from DHCS Division of Health Care Services indicating an individual received services of an emergent nature and indicating the covered dates of services is not a determination of eligibility.

580 D LOW-INCOME SUBSIDY (LIS) PROGRAM

Added a link to the LIS business process at Administrative MS 126-3 .

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #58

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 1, 2021

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2022. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 5.9% increase for 2022:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

This manual change also consists of several small technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at e-mail dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

512 SOCIAL SECURITY ENUMERATION

Renamed section to align with MAGI Modified Adjusted Gross Income Medicaid Manual

Added link to new Addendum 9 for the notice template when they must request a SSN Social Security Number from the SSA Social Security Administration

520 A APPLICATION AND REVIEW PROCESS

Revised section for clarity

Clarified that telephonically recorded application signatures are accepted through the Virtual Call Center (VCC)

Revised note to clarify that for paper applications, the signature must either be telephonically recorded by a caseworker through the VCC Virtual Call Center or a "wet signature"

522 A SPECIAL NON-IMMIGRANT GROUPS

Clarified that although a COFA Compact of Free Association migrant is exempt from the five-year waiting period, if their status changes to a qualified alien as outlined in APA MS 421-2, the five-year waiting period will apply unless they meet an exemption listed in APA MS 421-4(D).

554 D LOOK BACK PERIOD

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

570 C INDIVIDUALS NOT SUBJECT TO COST-OF-CARE

Clarified that individuals receiving Medicaid in the Refused Cash category are not responsible for cost-of-care

570 E INDIVIDUALS NOT SUBJECT TO COST-OF-CARE

Updated ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standard due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

570 H NURSING HOME EXAMPLES

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

570 J HOME AND COMMUNITY BASED WAIVER CASE EXAMPLES

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

580 MEDICARE SAVINGS PROGRAMS

Updated QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries and SLMB Specified Low Income Medicare Beneficiaries resource limits

ADDENDUM 1

Updated standards due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2022

Updated 2022 Spousal Impoverishment Standards

ADDENDUM 2

Changed terminology to "ineligible non-immigrants" for Medicaid Subtypes IL and II due to COFA Compact of Free Association migrants

ADDENDUM 9

Added a new addendum for the social security enumeration request letter template

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #59

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: April 1, 2022

We have updated the 2022 Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility effective April 1, 2022. We have also updated other sections that use Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility.

This manual change also consists of several technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below. If you have any questions please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at e-mail hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

514(G) Children in Treatment

Clarified that although an individual may not qualify for the Special LTC category until 30th day of institutionalization, the individual's effective date of eligibility is retroactive to the first day of the 30-day period of institutionalization.

520(A) Application and Review Process

Clarified that we can accept online application through the FFM and SSP for disability related Medicaid but additional information will be needed from the household.

534(K) Example of an Eligibility Determination

Updated examples with 2022 Federal Poverty Level Changes

534(M) Example of an Eligibility Determination With a Medicaid Qualifying Trust

Updated examples with 2022 Federal Poverty Level Changes

550(C) Special Long Term Eligibility

Clarified that although an individual may not qualify for the Special LTC category until day 30 of institutionalization, the individual effective date of eligibility is retroactive to the first day of the 30-day period of institutionalization.

575(B) Application

Updated LTC office address to 3901 Old Seward Highway Suite 131, Anchorage, AK 99503

580 Medicare Savings Program

Updated QMB and SLMB resource limits

Addendum 1

Updated with 2022 Federal Poverty Level Changes

Updated QMB and SLMB resource limits

Updated Pickle Chart

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #60

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 1, 2022

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy, clarifying existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

528 A INITIAL CASE PROCESSING

Revised the trust communication process now that the division has electronic document management.

530 C USE OF THE REFUSED CASH MEDICAID SUBTYPE

Added a note clarifying that the Refused Cash category should not be used for individuals residing in a LTC Long Term Care facility or receiving HCB Home and Community-Based Waiver services.

554 TRANSFER OF ASSETS

Revised section to clarify that a caseworker must review for a possible TOA penalty at every renewal to ensure that the individual did not make a non-allowable transfer in the prior 12 months.

570 C INDIVIDUALS NOT SUBJECT TO COST OF CARE

Clarified that individuals residing in a LTC facility are not exempt from cost of care and added a link to 570(B).

ADDENDUM 3 COUNTABLE AND EXCLUDED INCOME FOR ADLTC MEDICAID

Added new Addendum outlining basic countable and excluded income for ADLTC Medicaid.

ADDENDUM 9 SOCIAL SECURITY ENUMERATION REQUEST LETTER TEMPLATE

Revised signature line by removing "Eligibility Technician" as the Social Security Administration will not accept the form if it isn't signed by a member of management. Also, updated phone number to the VCC.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #61

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 1, 2022

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2023. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 8.7% increase for 2023:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

We have made several changes to clarify existing policy as a result of policy questions or suggestions from the field. An overview of the changes are listed below.

If you have any questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

ENTIRE MANUAL

Changed all references from DHSS Department of Health and Social Services to DOH Department of Health

520 B When an Application is Required

Added new subsection to clarify when an application is required

Renumbered section

520 C When an Application is Not Required

Added new subsection to clarify when an application is not required

Renumbered section

520 D Proof of Qualified Alien Status

Removed link to NCOSC website that no longer provides the information needed in this section. Updated to USCIS website.

521 Coordination with the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace

Added new section regarding coordination with the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace

Clarified when an individual is found ineligible for Medicaid (denial or closure), their information must be electronically transferred to the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace . So they can determine their eligibility for a Qualified Health Plan (QHP). Individuals who are found ineligible for Medicaid due e to procedural reasons and those who do not attest to U.S. citizenship or lawfully present non-citizen status should not be referred to the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace .

533 D Case Processing

Removed note indicating retroactive Medicaid is not available for TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248

554 D Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

570 E Individuals not Subject to Cost of Care

Updated ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standard due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

Revised section to clarify that the caseworker will determine eligibility without a deduction if the expense is not verified within 30 days of the initial application filing date. If verification is provided at a later date, the change is effective the first day of the month of the agency's receipt of the report of change

Added link to APA MS 480-3(C)

570 H Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

570 J Home and Community Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

580 D Low Income Subsidy (LIS) Program

Updated subsidy information

ADDENDUM 1

Updated standards due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2023

Updated 2023 Spousal Impoverishment Standards

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #63

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 1, 2023

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy, clarifying existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

521(A) APPLICATION SUBMITTED THROUGH THE FEDERALLY FACILITATED MARKETPLACE

Revised note to clarify that the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace referral must be made by sending the M070 as EIS Eligibility Information System cannot transfer client information electronically.

521(B) APPLICATION SUBMITTED THROUGH DPA Division of Public Assistance

Revised note to clarify that the FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace referral must be made by sending the M070 as EIS Eligibility Information System cannot transfer client information electronically.

524(L) ALASKA NATIVE AND AMERICAN INDIAN REAL PROPERTY RESOURCE EXCLUDED

Added noted clarifying that Alaska Native property remains exempt if it passes from AN/AI to one or more relatives, such as a spouse or child, even if the relative is not AN/AI.

ADDENDUM 3 COUNTABLE AND EXCLUDED INCOME FOR ADLTC MEDICAID

Added VA Disability as countable income

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #64

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 1, 2023

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2024. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 3.2% increase for 2024:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resources maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

We have made several changes to clarify existing policy as a result of policy questions or suggestions from the field. An overview of the changes are listed below.

If you have any questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

512 Social Security Enumeration

Removed reference to Addendum 9 and replaced with reference to new location of the Social Security Enumeration Letter Template.

514 D Penal Institution

Clarified that we cannot deny or terminate Medicaid benefits solely because an individual is incarcerated.

515 Continuous Eligibility and Children in SSI Supplemental Security Income Related Categories

Removed incarceration in a penal institution as a reason to end the continuous eligibility period.

554 D Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

554 F Transfer of Assets

Clarified transfer of asset presumption policy for Medicaid.

570 C Individuals not Subject to Cost of Care

Added note to clarify when it is appropriate to mail the M003 notice.

570 E Allowable deduction for Cost of Care determinations

Updated example of ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standard due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570 H Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570 J Home and Community Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

580 D Low Income Subsidy (LIS) Program

Updated resource limit and subsidy information.

ADDENDUM 1

Updated standards due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2024.

Updated 2024 Spousal Impoverishment Standards.

ADDENDUM 9 SOCIAL SECURITY ENUMERATION REQUEST LETTER TEMPLATE

Removed addendum so this letter template is not available to the public.

body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #67

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 2, 2024

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2025. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 2.5% increase for 2025:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resource maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

We have also made several changes to clarify existing policy as a result of policy questions or suggestions from the field. An overview of the changes are listed below.

If you have any questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

506 Medicare

Revised section to clarify that SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients are categorically eligible for Medicaid.

520(A) Application Process

Revised policy to allow for digital and handwritten signatures created on an electronic device (finder/stylus to screen) effective October 1, 2024.

Clarified that a request to add other programs to an existing Medicaid application must be done timely or a new application is required.

Revised note to clarify that FFM Federally Facilitated Marketplace and SSP Self Service Portal applications are valid for any category of Medicaid but additional information is needed from the household for ADLTC Aged, Disabled, and Long Term Care Medicaid categories.

520(C) Proof of United States Citizenship and Qualified Alien Status

Removed reference to a parent, guardian, or caretaker relative attesting to the identity of a child under the age of 16 by signing an identity declaration (the application) as this is not allowed without a wet signature.

526(D) Payments made from a QIT

Due to a federal regulation change effective September 30, 2024, removed food from in-kind support and maintenance ( ISM In-Kind Support and Maintenance ) calculations.

528(A) Initial Case Processing

Updated section to clarify that the MED 20 is not completed unless the Medicaid Qualifying Trust is used to establish or maintain Medicaid eligibility.

554(D) Look Back Period

Updated example due to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(D) Income Disregarded in the Cost of Care Determination

Changed Palmer Pioneer Home to Alaska Veterans and Pioneers Home due to a name change.

570(E) Allowable Deductions for Cost of Care Determinations

Updated example of ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standard due to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(H) Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(J) Home and Community Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated example due to the COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

575(B) Application

Revised section to include other application methods.

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Updated resource limits.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #68

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: April 1, 2025

We have updated the 2025 Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility effective April 1, 2025. We have also updated other sections that use Federal Poverty Level guidelines for income eligibility.

This manual change also consists of several technical changes or clarifications as a result of suggestions from the field. Highlights of these revisions are described below.

If you have any questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

505 Third Party Liability (TPL) and Recovery

Changed Child Support Services Division (CSSD) to Child Support Enforcement Division (CSED).

506(B) Medicare Enrollment

Removed instructions to refer an individual who is found to be ineligible for Medicare Savings Plan to the Social Security Office to apply for Medicare as DHCS Division of Health Care Services confirmed that this is an unnecessary step.

506(J) Social Security Offices

Removed the Ketchikan office as it is closed and updated fax and phone numbers for Anchorage, Juneau, and Fairbanks offices.

511 Child Support Cooperation

Changed Child Support Services Division (CSSD) to Child Support Enforcement Division (CSED).

513 Alaska Residency

Added note clarifying when caseworkers should consider Alaska residency questionable.

516 Retroactive Medicaid

Clarified that retroactive Medicaid uses actual income.

520(D) Reserved

Due to a federal rule change, removed the requirement to apply for other benefits as a condition of Medicaid eligibility.

522(B)5 Actions Taken on the Application

Clarified that Medicaid application withdrawal requests can be done with a recorded signature the VCC Virtual Call Center .

530(D) SSI Supplemental Security Income Disabled Adult Children

Clarified how to verify SSI Supplemental Security Income Disabled Adult Children eligibility.

534(K) Example of an Eligibility Determination

Updated examples with 2025 Federal Poverty Level Changes.

534(M) Example of an Eligibility Determination with a Medicaid Qualifying trust

Updated examples with 2025 Federal Poverty Level Changes.

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Clarified that SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients who are eligible for Medicare are automatically eligible for QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries and must be enrolled the first of the month after Medicaid eligibility is determined.

Clarified that SLMB Specified Low Income Medicare Beneficiaries can be authorized for up to 3 months prior to the QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries start date.

Addendum 1

Updated with 2025 Federal Poverty Level Changes

Updated Pickle chart

Addendum 5

Removed as an EIS Eligibility Information System notice listing exists in the Admin Manual.

body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #69

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 2, 2025

We are making several changes to incorporate new policy, clarifying existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals. Other changes are either technical in nature or clarifications that are the result of policy questions or suggestions from the field.

Highlights of these policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

ENTIRE MANUAL

Changed DHCS Division of Health Care Services TPL Third Party Liability Email to doh.hcs.rec.info@alaska.gov

Changed System operations and Help desk to Systems support

506(B) Medicare Enrollment

Clarified that an individual who appears to be eligible must apply for and pursue Medicare coverage.

Added note clarifying that if an individual applies for Medicare and is denied Part A because they would only be eligible if they pay for part A, Medicaid continues, and they would not be eligible for QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries .

520(C) Proof of United States Citizenship and Qualified Alien Status

Added note clarifying that the only states to issue Enhanced Driver's License (EDL/EID) are Washington, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, and Vermont.

520(E) Disability Determination

Added note to clarify that Social Security non-pay status does not necessarily mean that the individual is no longer disabled. An individual in non-pay status may still be eligible for Medicaid, providing they meet all other factors of eligibility.

522(E) Renewal Requirements

Added information regarding the ex parte process.

Added that federal regulations do not allow us to send a renewal form to the household unless we are unable to determine continued eligibility using the ex parte process.

Clarified that individuals who have no income counted on their case and no income is found when checking data sources can only be approved using the ex parte process if we received an application or renewal form attesting to zero income within the last 3 years. This means that the maximum number of ex parte renewals that can be approved for an individual who has no income counted on their case and no income is found when checking data sources is 3. After this time frame, a renewal form must be sent to the household for completion to attest to their income.

523(B) Reasonable Compatibility

Added note clarifying that the earned income exclusions are to be used before the comparison on both the client statement of earnings and DOL Department of Labor and Workforce Development verification.

524(L) Alaska Native and American Indian Real Property Resource Excluded

Clarified when property owned by an Alaska Native or American is sold, the proceeds are no longer exempt.

Linked to APA MS 440-3(C) .

533 Disabled Children at Home ( TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248 )

Changed DPA Division of Public Assistance TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248 Specialized Medicaid PAA Public Assistance Analyst to DPA Division of Public Assistance TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248 Project Assistant throughout the chapter.

533-C(4) DPA Division of Public Assistance is Responsible For

Clarified what type of coupons need to be issued and matched language to ADLTC 560 .

533-E(2) TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248 Reviews

Clarified that the caseworker are responsible for approving an LOC Level of Care extension request during the renewal process.

Clarified DDS Disability Determination Service denial procedure clarifying that the caseworker must send a copy of the DDS Disability Determination Service denial letter to policy email for required notice to go out.

570(F) When a Cost-of-Care Begins and Ends

Clarified Caseworkers must automatically enroll SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients who are receiving Medicare part A in the QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries program the first of the month after Medicaid eligibility is determined.

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Clarified Caseworkers must automatically enroll SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients who are receiving Medicare part A in the QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries program the first of the month after Medicaid eligibility is determined.

body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #70

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: December 1, 2025

This year Social Security announced a Cost of Living Allowance ( COLA Cost of Living Allowance ) increase effective January 2026. We have updated Addendum 1 and the examples throughout the manual with the following items to reflect the 2.8% increase for 2026:

An increase to the Long Term Care community spouse resource and income allowance and household member standards;

An increase to the Excess Home Equity resource maximum;

An increase to the Special Long Term Care Income Standard;

Changes in Medicare Part A and B premiums; and

Changes in Medicare Part D premium and coverage information, including changes to the Low-Income Subsidy program

We have also made several changes to clarify existing policy as a result of policy questions or suggestions from the field. An overview of the changes are listed below.

If you have any questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

506(A) Medicare Enrollment

Revised the note clarifying if an individual applies for Medicare and is denied Part A because they would only be eligible if they pay for part A, Medicaid continues, and the caseworker must make the QMB Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries determination.

520(D) Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA) Payments and Assets

Due to a new bill HR 42 revised section to include:

All ANCSA Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act distributions, including distributions from ANCSA Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act Settlement trusts, received from 7/7/25 - 7/6/30 are excluded as income in the month of receipt and as a resource if retained for aged 65 or older, blind, or disabled individuals.

These distributions are excluded as income in Cost of Care determinations for Special Long Term Care Waiver and institutional cases for the above listed individuals.

523(B) Reasonable Compatibility

Added note clarifying that "interface" should be used as verification in EIS Eligibility Information System for reasonable compatibility as client statement is not allowed for earned income.

523(K ) Development of Income

Added subsection to clarify development of income requirements no longer apply to Medicaid.

525(E) Hardship Exceptions

Clarified that a transfer of asset is the only hardship exception that can be allowed.

528(G) Trust Changes

Clarified the process for trustee changes.

Court paperwork assigning new trustee must be sent to policy for approval.

The Med 20 with new trustee information must be sent to DHCS Division of Health Care Services .

If the original trust is amended it must be sent to policy for review and approval.

554(D) Look Back Period

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(E)3 Allowable Deduction for Cost of Care Determinations

Updated example of ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program ANI Adult Not Included standard due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(G) Retroactive Cost of Care Adjustments

Clarified COCA Cost of Care understated liabilities can be captured in more than one month, such as when lump sum or sums were reported late.

You can increase the cost of care for multiple months when multiple lump sums were received in separate months.

570(H) Nursing Home Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

570(J) Home and Community Based Waiver Case Examples

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

580(D) Low Income Subsidy (LIS) Program

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

Addendum 1 Program Standards

Updated example due to COLA Cost of Living Allowance change.

Updated Medicare Part A, Part B, and Part D premiums for 2026.

Updated 2026 Spousal Impoverishment Standards.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: MC #73

MANUAL: Aged, Disabled and Long Term Care Medicaid Eligibility Manual

DATE: September 1, 2026

Beginning July 4, 2025 the 2025 Reconciliation Bill (H.R. 1) was signed into law. This law contains several provisions that affect the non citizen requirements of the Medicaid program that are effective October 1, 2026.

Highlights of these and other policy revisions are described below. If you have any questions, contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

500(A) Applicable Eligibility Categories

Revised section to remove automatic Medicaid eligibility for APA Adult Public Assistance and SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

501(A) Issuing Medicaid to Eligible Recipients

Revised section to reflect new process and new design of Medicaid cards.

511 B(1) Who is Not Required to Cooperate

Revised postpartum period from 60 days to 12 months to align with postpartum period change.

520(C) Proof of United States Citizenship and Qualified Alien Status

Removed reference to APA Adult Public Assistance MS 421, added reference to MAGI MS 808 , due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

522 Medicaid Exceptions to APA Adult Public Assistance Eligibility Policy

Added note to reflect individuals must meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

522(A) Special Non-Immigrant Groups

Removed reference to APA Adult Public Assistance MS 421, added reference to MAGI MS 808-2 and MAGI MS 808-4(D) due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

522(E) Renewal Requirements

Revised section to remove automatic Medicaid eligibility for SSI Supplemental Security Income recipients due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

530 SSI Supplemental Security Income and APA Adult Public Assistance Related Categories

Revised section to remove automatic Medicaid eligibility for SSI Supplemental Security Income and APA Adult Public Assistance recipients due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

Added note to reflect SSI Supplemental Security Income and APA Adult Public Assistance recipients and applicants must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

532 SSI Supplemental Security Income or APA Adult Public Assistance Ineligible for Reasons that Do Not Apply to Medicaid.

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

533(A) TEFRA Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act, P.L. 97-248 Eligibility

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

540 Grandfathered Eligibility Categories

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

550 Eligibility Categories for an Individual Living in an Institution

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

576(A) Definitions

Removed reference to APA Adult Public Assistance MS 421-6, added reference to MAGI MS 808-5 and MAGI MS 808-4 due to the Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.

580 Medicare Savings Programs

Added note to reflect individuals must also meet Medicaid qualified alien requirements effective October 1st, 2026.
